title: Welcome to the new Spiritual Meal
body: The app has grown: all hymn books in one place, a full Bible, sheet-music notes, favorites, daily words of wisdom, and now this blog. Open the menu (the three lines at the top left) to explore everything.

title: Find any hymn in seconds
body: Tap the search bar on the Home screen and type a hymn number, a title, or just a few words you remember from the song. Results come from every hymn book at once. Tired of choosing? Tap Surprise me for a random hymn.

title: God has something to say
body: Turn on Reminders in the menu to receive a word of wisdom every morning at 7am and every evening at 7pm.
